<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def knob_state(fr):
    l=fr.ascii.split('\n')
    out=[]
    for c in range(12,40):
        ok=True; pat=set()
        for r in range(19,23):
            for cc in range(c,c+4):
                ch=l[r][cc]
                if ch not in 'bS': ok=False;break
                pat.add(ch)
            if not ok: break
        if ok: out.append((c,[l[r][c:c+4] for r in range(19,23)]))
    # also 2x2
    for c in range(12,40):
        ok=True
        for r in range(19,21):
            for cc in range(c,c+2):
                if l[r][cc] not in 'bS': ok=False;break
            if not ok: break
        if ok and not any(abs(c-x)<=3 for x,_ in out):
            out.append((c,'2x2:'+l[19][c:c+2]+'/'+l[20][c:c+2]))
    return out
probes=['RIGHT','LEFT','UP','DOWN','UP','DOWN',
        {'action':'MOUSE','row':50,'col':30},
        {'action':'MOUSE','row':55,'col':25},
        {'action':'MOUSE','row':55,'col':30},
        {'action':'MOUSE','row':55,'col':35},
        {'action':'MOUSE','row':60,'col':30},
        'RIGHT','LEFT']
for p in probes:
    res=action([p])
    r=res if isinstance(res,dict) else {}
    print(p if isinstance(p,str) else p['action'], '->', knob_state(current_frame), 'changed:', r.get('board_changed'))
    if r.get('game_over') or r.get('run_complete') or r.get('done'):
        print('STOP'); break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

    for c in range(12,40):
